ios.desc:
Wipet is a focus challenge app that helps you eliminate loneliness and dive into deep work with your own virtual pet!
When you start a focus session, all distracting apps are blocked (except for the essentials) to ensure a deeply immersive experience.
Succeed in your challenge to get rewards about pet’s GrowthPoints and Cookies for your next session! 
Beyond simple blocking, feel the joy of growth with your companion.

[Who Needs Wipet? Your Key to Unlocking Potential]
1. Freelancers / Solopreneurs aiming for success: Losing out on income and work output due to constant distractions and social media notifications.
2. Students / Test-Takers struggling with discipline: Cannot maintain long study sessions because of the urge to connect and distracting boredom.
3. Anyone seeking balance and a new mindset: Wanting to find peace of mind and break the cycle of dopamine overload from endless scrolling.
4. Users who failed with basic blocking tools: Couldn't achieve lasting change with simple Screen Time or generic app limits.
